confirmation_prior_use: setup-outcomes-v1 one-shot holdout, read once on 2026-09-23 for the shadow ranker's acceptance test (docs/setup-outcomes-2026-09-23.md); declared second use, different hypothesis, read at most once for at most one arm
decision_rule: If no arm passes B1-B4: no_change; the confirmation window is not read. If one or more pass, the selected arm is read once on the confirmation window (B5): if it holds, eligible_bracket_change(arm), a separately specified card-construction PR (preview before enforce, operator approval); otherwise no_change. Reading: eligible_bracket_change(A2) or (A3) means the live ratchet is worth what the desk pays for it and the card's stated target should carry it; (A1) means the native target should be 3R; (A4) means the card should state a trailing exit and no fixed target. In every case the follow-up changes card construction only, states the measured arm record on the card, and ships preview first; nothing changes until that PR. no_change closes the bracket as an explanation for the native funnel's base rate: the entries, not the exits, are the problem, and the next work is on the entry side. All three windows (primary, robustness, confirmation) are used once for this test.
hypotheses: Population: setups replayed as the live desk scans them (10:35 and 14:35 New York, current long-only strategy configuration, 159-name current universe, SIP all-adjusted), over the primary window 2021-06-01 -> 2026-01-29 (decisions; bars through 2026-09-22), each labelled under five exit arms that share the entry (open of the first regular-session hourly bar at or after the decision), the planned stop, the planned risk unit R, the 20-session timeout and cost at 5 bp per side, so rows are paired by setup. Arms: A0_live (planned 2R target, no ratchet; byte-identical to the live labeller), A1_3r (3R target, no ratchet), A2_2r_trail (2R target with ratchet), A3_3r_trail (3R target with ratchet), A4_trail_only (no target, ratchet). Ratchet on hourly bars: at each completed regular-session bar's close, if close >= entry + 1.5R (trigger 1.5R, measured from the fill entry on the planned risk) the proposed stop is close - 1.5R (distance 1.5R); the stop becomes max(current stop, proposed) and takes effect from the next bar; exits through a ratcheted stop count as stop; a bar touching both stop and target counts as a stop; gaps fill at the open. Statistics: setup-weighted means; r and r_cost winsorised at +/-10R for statistics; stationary session-block bootstrap (block mean 10, 2000 draws, seed 20261018), whole sessions resampled once per draw and applied to every arm; one-sided p-values are the fraction of draws with the contrast <= 0; 90% CIs are the 5th and 95th percentiles. Rules, for each counterfactual arm i in A1..A4 (primary window unless stated): B1: the paired mean (excess_r_i - excess_r_A0) > 0 with Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05 over the four arms. B2: the arm's own mean R_cost has a 90% CI lower bound >= 0. B3: on the robustness window 2017-01-03 -> 2021-04-30 (bars through 2021-06-15) the paired excess advantage point estimate > 0. B4: at least 3000 labelled setups over at least 600 sessions, at least 95% of setups mature, and at least 300 setups whose A0 and arm-i outcomes differ (divergent pairs). An arm passes discovery when B1-B4 all hold; the selected arm is the passing arm with the largest B1 point estimate (ties: the earlier arm, A1 before A2 before A3 before A4). B5: the confirmation window 2026-03-02 -> 2026-08-14 is read once, for the selected arm and A0 only; the arm is eligible when its paired excess advantage over A0 is > 0 (point estimate) and its own mean R_cost is >= 0 there. Per-arm hit rates, timeout shares, holding sessions, market_r, strata, per-year means, unpaired means, 0 bp figures and live-card figures are descriptive only. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-18-bracket-counterfactual-design.md.
